name: Relay Will
body:
Your mental magic makes you a master of hypnosis.

Prerequisite(s): Conveyance focus

Benefit(s): Whenever you gain a bonus on Diplomacy checks from at least one spell you’ve cast, you may use the hypnotism skill unlock a number of additional times equal to the bonus for the spell’s duration. If the duration expires during the hypnotism before you implant a suggestion, you fail. You may gain no more uses in this way each day than your character level.
